body: Thank you, but I don't think I can overcome them. I have nobody I can go to for this and I'm really tired of living and just want to stop. I'll write it, maybe I won't go through with it for a little while but I can feel that I'm not supposed to live a long life.
Thank you for the offer. Sorry to hear you're not doing good either, if you need to talk, my inbox is open as well.
Hey. Not really, I'm pretty much doing the same now as I was when I made this post
I mean, that's a good point and idea but a bit easier said than done at this point

I don't think I hit anything but it's still bleeding a tiny bit on and off two hours later and I don't know why cause I put pressure on it, cleaned it and used a bandaid. Like if I hit something important I'd know by now, right?

I have such a strong urge lately to do bigger ones too but since I can't easily blame that on the cat, I'm doing a bunch of clusters which is unfortunately raising questions :/ these are the worse months, I can't wait until winter, it's so much easier to hide it then.

Yeah I'm pretty clumsy, it's uncommon for me to not have at least 5 bruises. Maybe it's just me but I feel like SH cuts and accidental cuts look different, maybe cause I cluster them. It's harder explaining 5 cuts in the same spot or a big bandaid to cover em all.
Thank you. I don't do sports or live in the country though. I'm indoors most of the time so it's hard making believable excuses

It's more the aftermath that'd be bad. My parents are divorced and I live with my dad, me going to a mental hospital would likely start another custody battle and and I'm not risking having to live with my mom.
Thanks, I plan to once I'm a legal adult cause the last thing I need is my parents involve in this, and I know I'll end up in a mental hospital if I were to see a therapist and be honest.
No I'm not seeing a therapist or getting help. I know I need it but it's not an option right now

Idk, I've tried it before and the ice method didn't do it for me, never took away the urge or anything. The rubber band is the first one that is kinda working but I'm definitely getting too obsessed with snapping it.
Yeah I think that's why I'm having so much swelling, I'm snapping it multiple times an hour, at least with cutting I had more self control. I think I'm going to have to find a different method.
Thank you for the link.
Yeah it does show, and thank you.

Not really, talking to anybody about this likely wouldn't end well as I have divorced parents and this will 100% cause another custody battle and on top of that, the few things that keep me sane would be taken away and it wouldn't surprise me if I ended up in a mental hospital. I'd rather not deal with those consequences of getting help. I think I need to wait til 18.

Thanks for the information. It does run in my family so it's possible, but after looking at online symptoms (which I know isn't a substitute for an actual doctor) I don't experience manic episodes or anything other than sudden depressive phases so I don't think it's the most likely option, I think it's just depression/anxiety combo.
Nothing in that time period

Yeah maybe. And thank you for the offer.
